name: Machinedrum Module
author: sd88me
summary: The Elektron Machinedrum SPS-1 UW sound engine as a native instrument: all 16 tracks from one plugin instance, with its own touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

requires_user_files.name: Elektron_SPS1-1UW_OS1.63.syx
requires_user_files.description: Your own Machinedrum UW OS 1.63 file. This is the sound engine, recompiled into your build.

requires_user_files.name: Machinedrum UW flash image (.bin)
requires_user_files.description: Your own full 8 MB flash image, used once at build time for the factory kits and the ROM sample memory.

needs: mpc-vst-monomodule's vst/build/art.json (the LCD fonts, made from your own Monomachine OS)
